description: Roll out an on-call schedule and escalation policy using PagerDuty for a 15-person SRE team. Must: define on-call rotation (primary + secondary), configure escalation rules (page primary → wait 5 min → page secondary → wait 10 min → page manager), set up service-to-team routing rules, configure business-hours vs after-hours policies, run a drill to verify paging works, and document the runbook. Risk factors: escalation delay too long causing slow response, misconfigured routing paging wrong team, drill not representative of real incident. Tools available: PagerDuty API, Slack, terraform, ansible.
